blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: It is commonly accepted that high-level concepts are represented linearly in the representation space of large neural networks. For Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs), finding those interpretable directions in visual representations is important for interpretability. To find them, the classical approach is to train a linear classifier on the representations, but it needs a large amount of labels and only recovers what can be read from the representations, not what the model actually uses. In this paper we start from the following insight: The LLM Decoder of an LVLM is also a classifier whose classes are the possible next tokens. So we use its first-order Taylor expansion as a linear classifier. Hence, we introduce Decoder-as-a-Probe (DaP), which significantly outperforms classical probing and steering baselines especially when training data is sparse. (1) It verbalizes what an LVLM perceives in a given image. (2) It can surgically change the perception of the LVLM about specific attributes (e.g. change only the color, the clothes worn or the action done). Due to its simplicity and data efficiency, we believe DaP can serve as a plug-and-play tool for LVLM research, such as interpretability, hallucination mitigation or instruction tuning.
blocks.zh: 一般认为,高层次的概念在大型神经网络的表示空间中线性地得到体现. 对于"大视觉语言模型"(LVLMs),在视觉表现中找到这些可解释的方向对于可解释性很重要. 要找到它们,古典的方法是在表示方式上训练出一个线性分类器,但是它需要大量的标签,并且只回收能够从表示方式读取的东西,而不是模型实际使用的东西. 在本文中,我们从以下的见解开始: LLM 解码器(LLM Decoder of a LVLM)也是一个分类器,其类是可能的下个符号. 因此,我们用它的一阶泰勒扩展作为线性分类器. 因此,我们引入了Decoder-as-a-Probe(DaP),这大大超过了传统的探测和引导基线,特别是在培训数据稀少的情况下。 (1) 它将LVLM在给定的图像中所感知的言语化. (2)它可以手术地改变LVLM对特定属性的感知(例如只改变颜色,所穿的衣服或完成的动作). 由于其简洁和数据效率,我们认为DaP可以作为LVLM研究的插件和播放工具,如可解释性,幻觉缓解或指令调取.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Representation learning is one of the great successes of computer vision, with models such as CLIP [ 40 ] . These vision encoders are now the eyes of Large Vision Language Models (LVLMs).
Indeed, in an LVLM, CLIP visual representations of the image are given to a Large Language Model (LLM Decoder) to answer a wide range of questions about it in natural language [ 23 , 2 ] .
blocks.zh:
代表性学习是计算机视觉的伟大成功之一,具有CLIP[40]等模型. 这些视觉编码器现在是大视觉语言模型(LVLMs)的眼睛.
实际上,在LVLM中,CLIP图像的视觉表现被赋予一个大语言模型(LLM Decoder),以自然语言回答与其相关的广泛问题[23,2].

blocks.en:
Yet, understanding how these representations encode high-level concepts is a key challenge in interpretability.
The dominant view, the
Linear Representation Hypothesis [ 27 , 35 ] , posits that high-level concepts are encoded as directions, so that an embedding decomposes as a weighted sum of concept directions ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle taxi ⟩ \rangle + ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle + ⟨ \langle metallic ⟩ \rangle ).
More recent work extends this view to take into account more elaborate structure of visual representations [ 46 , 10 ] .
They posit that concepts are grouped into multi-dimensional subspaces ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle taxi ⟩ \rangle among objects + ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle among colors).
In any case, accessing those interpretable concepts requires by definition only a linear operator.
Yet, finding those operators that allow us to interpret and steer the representation is usually tedious.

The standard tool to find such operators is the trained linear probe [ 44 , 1 , 19 , 21 , 41 ] . It fits a linear classifier on frozen representations to predict a concept, and then its weights are read as the concept direction.
However, linear probing suffers from three main limitations.
First, each probe requires a large labeled dataset, which must be collected for every concept of interest.
Second, and as a consequence, a probe only covers the classes it was trained on and does not generalize to unseen but connected concepts: a color probe fitted on ⟨ \langle blue ⟩ \rangle says nothing about ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle , although both could lie in the same color subspace.
Third, a probe only shows that a concept is linearly decodable, not that the LVLM actually uses this direction downstream [ 4 ] .
blocks.zh:
寻找此类操作员的标准工具是训练有素的线性探测器[44, 1, 19, 21, 41]. 它适合一个关于冻结表示的线性分类器来预测一个概念,然后它的权重被读作概念方向.
然而,线性探测有三个主要限制。
首先,每个探测器都需要一个带有大标签的数据集,必须为每个感兴趣的概念收集数据集.
第二,因此,一个探测器只覆盖它所训练的课程,并不概括到隐蔽的概念,而是连接的概念:一个安装在\\langle blue\\\rangle上的颜色探测器对\langle 黄色\\\rangle没有任何描述,尽管两者都可能位于同一个颜色子空间.
第三,探测器只显示一个概念可以线性解码,而不是LVLM实际使用这个方向下游[4].

blocks.en:
In this work, we circumvent all three limitations with a simple insight: the LLM Decoder of an LVLM has already learned to read out visual representations in order to answer questions about the image.
For example, to answer "Is the taxi yellow?" , the decoder must retrieve the direction of ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle from the visual tokens and turn it into the answer.
So why not use the decoder itself as the probe?
Inspired by LLM linearization methods [ 13 , 6 , 12 ] ,
we introduce Decoder-as-a-Probe (DaP) ,
which simply linearizes the LLM Decoder’s next-token prediction with respect to the input visual tokens for a given question prompt ( e.g . , "Which word best describes the color of this object?" ) (see Fig. 1 ).
The resulting operator is a Jacobian matrix that maps representations of the vision encoder onto the model vocabulary,
directly addressing the three limitations of probing.
(1) Only a few images are needed as anchor points for the linear approximation.
It requires no labels on these images, and uses the model’s answer to the question as the reference.
(2) It is not restricted to a fixed set of classes: since it maps visual representations onto the whole vocabulary, it can read out concept values never seen during estimation. (3) It is, by construction, an approximation of the computations the model performs itself to answer the question, making the resulting directions more efficient and precise at steering.
blocks.zh:
在这部作品中,我们以简单的洞察力来规避所有三个限制: LLM解码器一个LVLM已经学会读取视觉表现,以便回答有关图像的问题.
例如,要回答"出租车是黄色的吗?",解码器必须从视觉符号中检索\\\ langle黄色\\\\rangle的方向,并将其变成答案.
那为什么不用解码器做探测器呢?
受LLM线性化方法[13,6,12]的启发,
我们介绍Decoder-as-a-Probe(DAP),
它简单线性地将 LLM 解码器对特定问题提示(例如,“哪个词最能描述此对象的颜色?” ) 的输入视觉符号的下一个调值预测(见图1)。
由此产生的操作员是一个雅各比矩阵,将视觉编码器的表示图映射到模型词汇上,
直接解决探险的三个局限性.
(1)线性近似的锚点只需要几个图像.
它不需要这些图像上的标签,并以模型对问题的回答作为参考.
(2)它不局限于一组固定的类:由于它将视觉表现图映射到整个词汇中,它可以读取在估计时从未见到的概念值. (3) 通过构建,模型的计算近似于回答问题,使由此产生的方向在方向上更加有效和准确。

blocks.en: In summary, our contribution is DaP , a plug-and-play framework to estimate the direction of any concept in LVLM visual representation from a handful of images. These directions outperform previous baselines at steering with 256 times fewer training images, and extend to concepts never seen during estimation.
blocks.zh: 简而言之,我们的贡献是DaP,一个插件和游戏框架,从少数图像中估计LVLM视觉表现中任何概念的方向. 这些方向比以往的基线要好256倍的训练图像,并延伸到估计中从未见过的概念。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
When a large number of labels is available for a given concept,
to find its direction, the standard option is to fit a linear classifier [ 1 , 19 , 21 , 41 ] .
A simpler option is the Nearest Centroid Classifier (NCC), whose directions are the class centroids [ 43 ] . These directions steer better than those of trained probes [ 25 ] .
In LVLMs, both methods were used to study input visual tokens [ 44 ] .
blocks.zh:
当一个特定概念有大量的标签可用时,
标准选项是安装线性分类器[1、19、21、41]。
一个比较简单的选项是最接近的Centroid分类器(NCC),其方向是类百分数[43]. 这些方向比训练有素的探测器方向要好
在LVLMs中,两种方法都被用于研究输入视觉符号[44].

blocks.en:
Logit-Lens [ 30 ] can use the LLM unembedding matrix to read interpretable concepts in visual tokens of LVLMs [ 29 ] .
These concepts are vocabulary text tokens that match the object the token covers ( e.g . , "␣taxi" ).
However, whereas last-layer visual tokens can be decoded, it works much less in the input layer, making it poorly suited to steering.
Recently, to better decode concepts at the input layer, Emb-Lens [ 16 , 8 , 38 ] uses the embedding matrix, since input visual tokens live in the same space as input text token embeddings.
The main problem of Lenses is that they mostly give the name of the object (see Fig. 2 ).
DaP instead can decompose a token into its attributes by asking a different question for each attribute.
blocks.zh:
Logit-Lens [30] 可以使用LLM未嵌入矩阵在LVLMs的视觉符号中读取可解释的概念 [29].
这些概念是词汇文本符号,与符号封面对象(如"QQtaxi")相匹配.
然而,虽然最后一层的视觉符号可以解码,但是在输入层中效果却要小得多,使得它不太适合向导.
最近,为了更好地解码输入层的概念,Emb-Lens [16,8,38] 使用嵌入矩阵,因为输入视觉符与输入文本符嵌入的空间相同.
伦西斯的主要问题是,他们大多给出了物体的名称(见图2).
DAP转而可以通过对每个属性提出不同的问题来将一个符号分解为它的属性.

blocks.en:
Sparse Autoencoders (SAEs) have gained significant traction in recent years [ 15 , 9 , 32 ] .
By training on a large corpus of unlabeled data, SAEs decompose superposed concepts into a large dictionary of directions.
However, they are often unstable to train [ 36 , 9 ] and
naming these directions with interpretable concepts takes extra machinery [ 37 , 49 , 42 ] .
Moreover, these directions offer limited steerability [ 5 , 26 ] .
DaP, in contrast, is plug-and-play, as it needs only a few images, targets the concept chosen by the question and gives steerable directions.
Still, SAEs give a full sparse decomposition of the representation.
blocks.zh:
Sparse自动编码器(SAEs)近年来获得了显著的牵引力[15,9,32].
通过对大量无标签数据的培训,SAEs将叠加的概念分解成一个大的方向词典.
然而,它们往往不稳定,无法训练[36,9]和
以可解释的概念命名这些方向需要额外的机械[37、49、42]。
此外,这些指示提供了有限的可导性[5、26]。
相比之下,DAP是插件和游戏,因为它只需要几个图像,针对问题所选择的概念,给出可引导的方向.
尽管如此,SAEs还是对代表的分解十分稀疏.

blocks.en:
The Jacobian gives a local linear approximation of a network computation, and is used by the language community to find computations performed by LLMs that can be approximated by a linear operator.
LRE [ 13 ] approximates how an LLM maps a fact about a subject.
Later, LRC [ 6 ] inverted this linear map to get concept directions ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle located in France ⟩ \rangle for cities such as ⟨ \langle Paris ⟩ \rangle ).
Our work builds on this approximation, which we adapt and extend to visual input representations in four ways.
(1) We propose a framework in which the prompt is an open or closed question, so that any concept can be probed.
(2) We extend the linearization to objects that span several image tokens.
(3) We use the unembedding matrix as a dictionary of concept direction anchors to reduce the reliance on labels, generalize to unseen concepts and remove the costly matrix inversions.
(4) We propose using the bias as a gate on the vocabulary.
Recently, J-Lens [ 12 ] has used the Jacobian to map hidden states from middle LLM layers to all future last-layer hidden states. By verbalizing these intermediate hidden states with the unembedding matrix, it reveals the reasoning the model carries out along its layers.
blocks.zh:
雅各比亚语给出了网络计算的局部线性近似值,被语言界用来寻找LLMs完成的可以由线性运算符进行近似化的计算.
LRE[13]大概是一个LLM如何描绘一个主题的事实.
后来,LRC [6] 将这个线性地图反转,以获得概念方向(例如, \\\ langle 位于法国 \\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\
我们的工作建立在这种近似的基础上,我们从四个方面调整和扩展到视觉输入表达。
(1) 我们提出一个框架,在该框架中,及时性是一个开放或封闭的问题,以便任何概念都能被探索。
(2)我们把线性化扩展到跨越多个图像符号的物体.
(3)我们使用未嵌入式矩阵作为概念方向锚点的词典,以减少对标签的依赖,概括到看不见的概念,并去除昂贵的矩阵反演.
(4) 我们提议在词汇中将偏差作为大门。
最近,J-Lens [12] 利用雅各比亚号将隐藏状态从LLM中层映射到所有未来的末层隐藏状态. 通过将这些中间隐藏状态与未嵌入的矩阵进行语言化,它揭示了模型沿其层展开的推理.

blocks.en: 3 Motivation
blocks.zh: 3 动机

blocks.en:
A concept is defined as any interpretable and high-level property, like ⟨ \langle wearing a hat ⟩ \rangle , ⟨ \langle being a taxi ⟩ \rangle or ⟨ \langle being yellow ⟩ \rangle .
The Linear Representation Hypothesis states that concepts are represented linearly in the representation space of neural networks [ 35 ] .
The power of this hypothesis lies in the fact that we can therefore use linear algebra to steer and interpret concepts inside the model. This is why finding concept directions is essential to interpret model activations.
It has been studied and largely confirmed in LLMs [ 25 ] .
Moreover, prior work [ 34 ] shows that concept directions are not arranged arbitrarily in the representation space but follow a hierarchical structure ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle mammal ⟩ \rangle decomposes as ⟨ \langle animal ⟩ \rangle plus an orthogonal ⟨ \langle mammal ⟩ \rangle part).
blocks.zh:
一个概念被定义为任何可解释和高级的属性,比如\\langle戴着帽子\\rangle,\\langle是出租车\\\rangle或\langle是黄色\\\\rangle。
线性表示假说指出,概念在神经网络的表示空间中线性表示[35].
这个假说的力量在于我们因此可以使用线性代数来引导和解释模型内部的概念. 这就是为什么找到概念方向对于解释模型激活至关重要.
LLMs [25] 研究并基本证实了这一点。
此外,前作[34]显示,概念方向不是任意排列在表示空间中,而是遵循一个等级结构(例如,\\\ langle哺乳动物\\\\rangle分解为\\ langle动物\\\\\rangle+一个正弦哺乳动物\\\\\\rangle部分).

blocks.en:
Still, for representations derived from images, we can expect even more structure than for text.
Visual inputs are continuous , meaning two banana pictures are never exactly the same shade of yellow and the same length. By contrast, the text token embedding of "␣yellow" is discrete and fixed around a finite vocabulary.
This was first formalized in cognitive science as conceptual spaces [ 11 ] .
Continuity should have implications for the induced representations.
This is why Fel et al. [10] recently proposed a refined view in which image representations are composed of a sum of convex mixtures
( e.g . , ⟨ \langle taxi ⟩ \rangle among objects, ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle among colors, and ⟨ \langle metallic ⟩ \rangle among materials).
Following this view, we consider in this paper that any attribute type ( e.g . , colors or materials) can be read with a single linear projection.
blocks.zh:
然而,对于来自图像的表述,我们可以期望比文本更有结构。
视觉输入是连续的,意思是两张香蕉图片 从来没有完全一样的遮蔽 黄色和相同的长度。 相比之下,嵌入"QQYELLOW"的文本符号是离散的,固定在一个有限的词汇周围.
这在认知科学中首次被正式确定为概念空间[11].
连续性应对引致的表述产生影响。
故法尔等. [10] 最近提出了一个精细的视图,其中图像表示由对流混合物的总和组成
(例如, \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ \ 
根据这一观点,我们在本文中考虑,任何属性类型(例如颜色或材料)都可以用单一的线性投影读取.

blocks.en:
A related but distinct idea is the superposition hypothesis [ 7 ] .
It states that the number of dimensions of a hidden state is much smaller than its total concept representational capacity.
This is possible if we assume that
(1) concepts are encoded as quasi-orthogonal directions forming an overcomplete frame [ 45 ] ;
and (2) only a sparse set of concepts is activated at a given time.
The unembedding matrix W U W_{U} of an LLM gives a direct example of superposition as
it up-projects the hidden dimension of the LLM to a token vocabulary that is usually many times bigger ( e.g . , 60 × 60\times for Qwen3-VL-4B [ 2 ] , from 2,560 to 151,936).
In this paper, we leverage the fact that
most concepts can be represented by a token ( ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle → \to "␣yellow" , ⟨ \langle metallic ⟩ \rangle → \to "␣metallic" ).
Thus, we could use the unembedding matrix as a free, labeled dictionary of concept directions. However, directly applying W U W_{U} to input visual embeddings gives poor results [ 29 ] and does not allow selecting a given attribute subspace.
This is why, in the following section, we introduce DaP, which overcomes these limitations by finding, given a prompt, the linear operator J π J_{\pi} that maps visual embeddings to an aligned space for W U W_{U} readout.
blocks.zh:
一个相关但截然不同的想法是叠加假设[7].
它指出,隐藏状态的维度比其整体概念代表能力小得多.
如果我们假设
(1) 概念被编码为形成超完整框架的准正弦方向[45];
和(2) 在特定时间只激活了一组稀少的概念。
一个 LLM 的未嵌入矩阵 W U WQQU} 提供了一个直接的叠加实例 :
它将 LLM 的隐藏维度投射到一个通常大很多倍的符号词汇(例如,Qwen3-VL-4B的60×60\时间[2],从2,560到151,936).
在本文中,我们利用这一事实:
大多数概念可以用一个符号来表示(\\ langle 黄色\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\“Yellow”,\\ langle 金属\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\“金属”)。
因此,我们可以使用未嵌入式矩阵作为概念方向的自由的,标签的词典. 然而,直接应用W U WQQU}输入视觉嵌入会给出差的结果[29],不允许选择给定的属性子空间.
这就是为什么我们在下面的一节中引入了DaP,它克服了这些局限性,在给出一个迅速的线性运算符J Q ~ J_{\pi},将视觉嵌入图映射到W U W_{U}读取的对齐空间.

blocks.en: 4 The Decoder-as-a-Probe Framework
blocks.zh: 4 解码-as-a-Probe框架

blocks.en:
First, we show that an LLM Decoder can be interpreted as a classifier, then that an LLM Decoder can be linearized.
Lastly, we show how to combine both to get a linear probe programmable by a prompt.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们显示LLM解码器可以解释为分类器,然后LLM解码器可以线性化.
最后,我们展示如何结合两者,以获得一个线性探测器的可编程性通过一个即时.

blocks.en: This next-token prediction naturally lets us interpret the LLM Decoder as a classifier.
blocks.zh: 接下来的预测自然让我们将LLM解码器解释为一个分类器.

blocks.en: 4.1 Decoder as a Classifier
blocks.zh: 4.1 解码器作为分类器

blocks.en:
The prompt π \pi can be formulated so that the next-token prediction of the LLM Decoder is the answer to a question about the image, with 𝒜 ⊆ 𝒱 \mathcal{A}\subseteq\mathcal{V} the set of possible answers.
For example, "Is the man wearing a hat? Answer yes or no." with 𝒜 = { "yes" , "no" } \mathcal{A}=\{\mbox{{"yes"}},\mbox{{"no"}}\} .
Then the next-token prediction can be turned into a classifier by
restricting the softmax to the answer tokens 𝒜 \mathcal{A} giving: p π ​ ( t ∣ 𝐕 ) = e z t ∑ t ′ ∈ 𝒜 e z t ′ , t ∈ 𝒜 . p_{\pi}(t\mid\mathbf{V})=\frac{e^{z_{t}}}{\sum_{t^{\prime}\in\mathcal{A}}e^{z_{t^{\prime}}}},\quad t\in\mathcal{A}. (2)

We can also ask an open question to the model, with 𝒜 = 𝒱 \mathcal{A}=\mathcal{V} , e.g . , "Which word best describes the color of this object?" .
This holds for any concept category ( e.g . , object name, shape, material, activity).
If a set of colors to probe is known in advance, the answer space can be restricted to those colors. However, for interpretability it is important to be able to discover representations present in the model that could not have been anticipated; this is why keeping the answer set open is valuable.

我们还可以向模型提出一个开放的问题,其中A=V\mathcal{A}=\mathcal{V},例如"哪个词最能描述这个物体的颜色? 。 。 。
对任何概念类别(例如:对象名称、形状、材料、活动)来说,此控件。
如果提前知道要探测的一组颜色,答案空间可以限制在这些颜色上. 然而,对于可解释性而言,必须能够发现模型中无法预见的表述;这就是为什么保持答案集是有价值的。

blocks.en:
In both the open and closed cases, the classifier is the LLM Decoder itself, which is not linear in the visual tokens. Turning it into a linear probe requires linearizing it with respect to the visual tokens.
Unlike in text [ 13 , 12 ] , a concept in an image is spread over many visual tokens, which makes this linearization not straightforward.
blocks.zh:

与文本[13,12]不同,一个图像中的概念分布在许多视觉符号上,这使得这种线性化不是直截了当的.

blocks.en:
Training neural networks with cross-entropy loss makes the last-layer representations of same label inputs nearly identical, a phenomenon called neural collapse [ 33 ] .
In LLMs, this collapse makes inputs that lead to the same next token end up with almost identical last-layer hidden states [ 47 , 22 ] . This nonlinearity behaves as a smooth approximation of a step function and leads to noisy Jacobian estimates [ 12 ] .
Building on this observation, in open classification, we estimate 𝐡 \mathbf{h} at the penultimate layer, which improves performance.
blocks.zh:
训练神经网络具有交叉内质损失,使得同一标签输入的末层表现几乎完全相同,这种现象被称为神经崩溃[33].
在 LLMs 中,这种崩溃使得导致同一下个符号的输入最终以几乎相同的最后一层隐藏状态[47,22]. 这种非线性表现为一步函数的平滑近似,导致雅各比亚语的噪音估计[12].
基于这一观察,在公开分类中,我们估计h\ mathbf{h}在倒数第二层,这可以提高性能.

When the prompt asks an open question, DaP verbalizes its answer over the whole vocabulary ( 𝒜 = 𝒱 \mathcal{A}=\mathcal{V} ).
We noticed that when the bias is removed,
words related to the object but not part of the answer space appear ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle taxi ⟩ \rangle instead of ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle )
and some answers are correct but in other languages, such as Chinese.
As the LVLM does not produce those artifacts, we know they are due to the linearization.
Hence, the bias plays the role of the attribute subspace selector ,
giving a low prior to tokens that are not part of the answer space.
To address this issue, we use the bias as a gate in open classification.
More precisely, we restrict the answer space 𝒜 \mathcal{A} to the top- k k tokens with the highest bias logits W U ​ 𝐛 π W_{U}\mathbf{b}_{\pi} (see Fig. 1 ).
This gate multiplies each answer probability by a binary mask, equal to one for these k k tokens and zero for the others.
We use k = 200 k=200 for attribute types and k = 5000 k=5000 for naming objects, which have more possible answers.

blocks.en:
We use the Visual Attributes in the Wild (VAW) dataset [ 39 ] .
It consists of 261k object instances annotated with an object name, a bounding box and a list of attributes, using images from Visual Genome [ 20 ] .
VAW contains 620 different attributes, which are hierarchically grouped into attribute types, the four largest being Colors, Materials, Shapes and Activities.
We crop images around the object bounding box with a 20% margin.
blocks.zh:
我们使用野生的视觉属性数据集[39].
它由261k个对象实例组成,并附有对象名称,边框和属性列表,使用来自Visual Genome[20]的图像.
VAW包含620个不同的属性,这些属性按照等级分类为属性类型,最大的四个是色彩,材料,形状和活动.
我们用20%的边距 剪切物体周围的图像

blocks.en:
Model: We use Qwen3-VL-4B. Results with other models are shown in the supplementary material F . Tasks: We evaluate three concept probing tasks, defined by the following prompts:
(1) Object Names. "Which word best names the thing in the middle of the image?" ;
(2) Attribute Types. "Which word best describes the { attribute type } of the { object name }?" , with attribute type being color, material, shape and activity;
(3) All Attributes.
Most attributes are not part of an attribute type or part of a small one, so we probe all attributes independently using a binary classification task
with the prompt "Is the { object name } { attribute }? Answer yes or no." Baselines: We compare against a trained linear probe [ 44 ] , NCC [ 43 ] and Emb-Lens [ 8 ] .
We evaluate in a few-shot setup, where regularization plays an important role in performance [ 48 ] . For the trained linear probe, we thus use closed-form ridge regression [ 14 , 3 ] with the regularization hyperparameter that gives the best validation accuracy for each task and shot count.
blocks.zh:
型号:我们使用Quen3-VL-4B. 其他模型的结果见补充材料F。 任务 : 我们评价三项概念探测任务,由下列提示确定:
(1)对象名称. "哪一个词最好的名字 在画面中间的东西?" · ;
(2) 属性类型。 “哪一个词最能描述{对象名称}的{属性类型}?",属性类型是颜色、材料、形状和活动;
(3) 所有属性。
大多数属性不是属性类型的一部分,也不是小属性的一部分,所以我们使用二进制分类任务独立地探索所有属性.
即时 “是{对象名称}{属性}吗? 回答是或否". 基线: 我们比较一个训练有素的线性探测器[44],NCC[43]和Emb-Lens[8].
我们用几个镜头来评价,其中规范化在绩效中发挥着重要作用[48]. 对于训练有素的线性探测器,我们使用封闭式山脊回归[14,3],并配有规范的超参数,为每项任务提供最佳的验证精度并进行点数.

blocks.en:
First, for Object Names and Attribute Types, the probe is fitted on the four concepts with the most training instances. We refer to them as the seen concepts. We fit each method on 16 images (shots) per seen concept. Only the trained probe and NCC need labels at estimation.
Only DaP, Emb-Lens and the model can be evaluated on unseen concepts.
For each task, we estimate J π J_{\pi} with the prompt π \pi of that task.

While VAW contains 927k concept annotations, it is highly unbalanced, as the median concept has only 94 training instances.
This is why we evaluate DaP at 16 shots, which we consider a realistic setting.
For All Attributes, VAW also provides explicit negative labels, so we sample 16 positive and 16 negative training instances per concept.
This lets us probe the 570 of the 620 VAW attributes that have at least 16 training and test samples.
There are no unseen concepts, and Emb-Lens cannot be evaluated on All Attributes.
Full experimental details are given in the supplementary material ( Appendix B ).
blocks.zh:
虽然暴力侵害妇女问题包含927k的概念说明,但极为不平衡,因为中位概念只有94个培训实例。
这就是为什么我们用16个镜头来评价DAP, 我们认为这是一个现实的环境。
对于所有属性,暴力侵害妇女问题也提供了明显的负面标签,因此我们每个概念抽样16个正面和16个负面培训实例。
这让我们可以调查至少16个培训和测试样本的620个暴力侵害妇女特征中的570个。
没有隐形概念,无法在所有属性上评价Emb-Lens。
完整的试验细节载于补充材料(附录B)。

blocks.en:
We evaluate the capacity of each linear probe to detect the presence of a concept. Table 1 shows the closed accuracy on seen and unseen concepts.
For a fair comparison, we show closed accuracy for DaP, Emb-Lens and the LVLM for reference. Otherwise, since Emb-Lens is unable to select attributes, it would score near 0.
The trained probe and NCC, with few labeled instances and no prompt to specify what to look for, rely on the most salient information in the visual embedding, which is the object identity. As a result, DaP outperforms all baselines on every attribute type, even at 1 shot.
blocks.zh:
我们评价每个线性探测器 探测一个概念的存在的能力 表1显示所见和所见概念的封闭准确性。
为了进行公平的比较,我们显示DaP,Emb-Lens和LVLM的闭合精度以供参考. 否则,由于Emb-Lens无法选择属性,它将得分接近0.
训练有素的探测器和NCC(NCC),很少标注实例,并且没有及时指定寻找什么,依赖于视觉嵌入中最突出的信息,即物体身份. 因此,DaP在每种属性类型上都超越了所有基线,即使是在1镜头.

blocks.en:
The aim of DaP is not to be the best detector of a concept, but to be faithful to the model’s perception, i.e . , to give the answer the model gives for each object, making DaP bounded by the model accuracy. For example, on Object Names, DaP (78.7) is less accurate than the LVLM itself (82.3), which is less accurate than the trained probe (86.8) [ 44 ] .
We provide faithfulness results, which favor DaP by design, in the supplementary material C .
Yet, on the 1,313 object names never seen during estimation, DaP reaches a top-1 accuracy of 24.3%, close to that of the model (28.5%), and more than twice that of Emb-Lens (10.6%).
More generally, DaP at 16 shots largely outperforms Emb-Lens.
blocks.zh:
DaP的目的不是成为概念的最佳探测器,而是忠实于模型的感知,即给出模型为每个对象给出的答案,使DaP以模型的准确性为界限. 例如,在对象名称上,DaP(78.7)比LVLM本身(82.3)更准确,比训练的探测器(86.8)[44]更准确.
我们在补充材料C中提供了忠实的结果,这在设计上有利于DAP。
然而,在估计期间从未见过的1,313个对象名称上,DaP达到了24.3%的最高精度,接近模型的精度(28.5%),超过Emb-Lens的两倍(10.6%).
更一般地说,DAP在16发子弹时的表现基本超过Emb-Lens.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the capacity of each linear probe to steer the answer of the model toward a target concept.
Steering is successful when the answer of the steered model is the target concept.
To avoid favoring DaP, we steer the model with a task question different from the one used to estimate DaP, and we show in the supplementary material G the results when steering with a question in another language.
As in Eq. 11 , each probe steers the visual tokens of the object along the difference between its target and source concept directions ( δ \delta ), for a given steering strength α \alpha . Table 2 (left) shows the steering success rate for α = 1 \alpha=1 , and Tab. 2 (right) shows the steering success rate for Attribute Types as a function of α \alpha . For Attribute Types, DaP 1-shot needs ∼ 2 × {\sim}2\times less steering strength than the linear probe trained on 256 shots. Interestingly, Emb-Lens can probe concepts but is remarkably poor at steering, which may explain why previous work only uses it for readout [ 16 , 8 , 38 ] . As a result, among all methods, only DaP can steer toward unseen concepts. Also, steering the object name is harder, as the object identity takes up a large part of the visual embedding.
blocks.zh:
我们评估每个线性探测器 将模型的答案导向目标概念的能力
当被引导模式的答案是目标概念时,引导是成功的.
为了避免偏爱DaP,我们用一个不同于用于估算DaP的任务问题来引导模型,我们在补充材料G中以另一种语言对一个问题进行引导时显示结果.
如同Eq. 11中,每个探测器按其目标与源概念方向的区别来引导物体的视觉信号(\\\ delta ),为给定方向强度α\α. 表2(左)显示 α = 1\ alpha = 1 的引导成功率,表2(右)显示 α\ alpha 函数的属性类型的引导成功率。 对于属性类型,DaP 1-shot需要 \\ 2 × \ sim}2\时间比256发子弹训练的线性探测器少。 有趣的是,Emb-Lens可以探究概念,但方向非常差,这可以解释为什么先前的工作只用于读取[16、8、38]。 因此,在所有方法中,只有DaP能够向隐形概念方向前进. 另外,引导对象名称更难,因为对象身份占据了视觉嵌入的很大一部分.

blocks.en:
We additionally measure the steering specificity of each probe. Specificity measures how much the steering leaves the LVLM perception of unrelated concepts unchanged.
For this, we ask the model questions about unrelated concepts before and after steering.
For a fair comparison, each method steers at the α \alpha that gives a steering success rate of 40% ( Tab. 3 ). For All Attributes, DaP changes the object name 4 × 4\times less often than the trained probe and NCC.
blocks.zh:
我们进一步测量每个探测器的转向特性。 具体度衡量方向使LVLM对不相关概念的认识保持不变的程度。
为此,我们向模型提出在指导前后无关的概念问题。
为了进行公平的比较,每种方法在 α\ alpha 上进行引导,使引导成功率达到 40% (Tab. 3 ) 。 对于所有属性, DAP 修改对象名称 4× 4\ 时间比训练的探测器和 NCC 少 。

blocks.en:
In this section, we provide concrete examples of using DaP to probe and steer visual embeddings, as we think that this is more insightful than numbers on a benchmark. However, in an effort to prevent cherry-picking and to show the versatility and robustness of the method,
all experiments are done using the standard “ironing man” image [ 31 , 23 ] .
We provide additional qualitative results in the supplementary material D.3 and D.4 .
blocks.zh:
在本节中,我们提供了使用DaP探测和引导视觉嵌入的具体例子,因为我们认为这比基准上的数字更有洞察力。 然而,为了防止采摘樱桃,并显示这一方法的多用途性和稳健性,
所有实验都使用标准的“roning man”图像[31,23]进行。
我们在补充材料D.3和D.4中提供了额外的质量结果。

blocks.en: 6.1 Verbalizing
blocks.zh: 6.1 口头禅

blocks.en:
Although DaP is estimated to answer about the concept of a given object,
we can use it to decode concepts at every patch of the image ( ℳ = { i } \mathcal{M}=\{i\} ). Figure 2 shows readouts of DaP for Object Names, Color and Material concept subspaces, as well as the ⟨ \langle hanging ⟩ \rangle concept direction.
Text tokens predicted are scaled by the probe token probability.
By comparison with Emb-Lens, DaP outputs are more consistent, mainly in English, and more interpretable.
blocks.zh:
虽然DaP被估计用来回答特定对象的概念,
我们可以使用它来解码图像的每个补丁(M={i}\ mathcal{M}=\{i\}})的概念. 图2显示对象名称、颜色和材料概念子空间的DAP读取,以及\\\langle hanging\\\\rangle概念方向。
预言的文本符由探测符符概率缩放.
与Emb-Lens相比,DAP输出更加一致,主要以英语为主,更能解释.

blocks.en: 6.2 Steering
blocks.zh: 6.2 指导

blocks.en:
One possible concern is that DaP only steers successfully in its restricted fitting setup
when directly asking the model about the attributes of interest.
This is why, in this section, we test steering the model by only asking indirect questions that do not directly query the attributes of interest.
blocks.zh:
一个可能的关切是,DAP只在有限的装配设置中成功引导
当直接询问模型中的利益属性时。
这就是为什么在本节中,我们仅通过提出不直接查询利益属性的间接问题来测试对模型的引导.

blocks.en:
For the first example, we ask the standard question "What is unusual about this image?" , but this time asking for two unusual events, while steering the color of the yellow taxi toward ⟨ \langle pink ⟩ \rangle .
Results are shown in Fig. 3 (a).
Here, the DaP probe was estimated on neither ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle nor ⟨ \langle pink ⟩ \rangle objects,
demonstrating its ability to generalize to unseen concept directions.
blocks.zh:
第一个例子是,我们问一个标准问题,“这幅图有什么不同寻常之处?” 但这次要求的是两个不同寻常的事件,同时将黄色出租车的颜色导向\\\ langle粉红色\\\\\\rangle。
结果见图3(a)。
这里,DAP探测器 既不在\\langle黄色\\\rangle上 也不在\langle粉红色\\\\\rangle物体上,
证明它有能力将概念方向概括到看不见的地方。

blocks.en:
Next, we noticed that the model justifies that the left taxi is moving based on its motion blur.
Conveniently, one of the VAW concepts we estimated was ⟨ \langle blurry ⟩ \rangle .
Once we remove the ⟨ \langle blurry ⟩ \rangle direction, the model says that the car has stopped (see Fig. 3 (c)).
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们注意到模型证明 左侧的出租车移动是基于它的运动模糊。
据我们估计,
一旦我们移除\\ langle模糊\\\\rangle方向, 模型说汽车已经停止(见图3(c))。

blocks.en:
Next, we test modifying 2 concepts while adding 2 more concepts to the taxi on the same visual tokens.
For honesty, we noticed that when steering 4 attributes at the same time while asking indirect questions, the model may not surface all concepts in its answer, and the result is sensitive to prompt variations.
Here we selected the result in Fig. 3 (e) as it shows:
(1) The unsteered answer surfaces the 2 modified concepts.
(2) The steered answer successfully surfaces the 4 new concepts.
(3) We also steer the model to perceive the taxi as ⟨ \langle parked ⟩ \rangle while keeping the blur, which results in the model hallucinating a cause for the blur (underlined).
blocks.zh:
接下来,我们测试修改两个概念,同时在同一视觉符号上在出租车上添加两个概念.
老实说,我们注意到,当引导4属性的同时提出间接问题时,模型可能不会在答案中浮出所有概念,结果对迅速的变化很敏感.
我们在这里选择了图3(e)所示的结果:
(1)未发音的回答表露出两个修改后的概念.
(2) 定向答案成功地提出了4个新概念。
(3)我们也引导模型将出租车视为\\langle 停车\\\rangle同时保持模糊,这导致模型幻觉模糊的原因(线下).

blocks.en:
In most examples, steering does not impair the model’s ability to perceive other concepts in the steered area.
For example, when adding ⟨ \langle in costume ⟩ \rangle , it continues to perceive the clothes as yellow (see Fig. 3 (b)).
Or, more notably, the model retrieves "with motion blur … visible roof-mounted light and tinted windows" after 4 attributes are added on top of the taxi.
Also, the coherence and fluency of the model’s sentences seem unaffected by the steering. Notably, the steered and unsteered answers diverge at the moment the model reads the attribute ( e.g . , "The man likely feels a mix of frustration" → \rightarrow "… of cold" , see Fig. 3 (d)).
blocks.zh:
在大多数例子中,指导并不影响模型在指导领域理解其他概念的能力。
例如,在增加\\ langle在服装\\\rangle时,它继续将衣服视为黄色(见图3(b))。
或者,更值得注意的是,该型号在出租车顶部添加了4个属性之后,"带有运动模糊......可见的屋顶挂灯和有锡的窗户".
此外,该模式的句子的一致性和流利性似乎不受指南的影响。 值得注意的是,在模型读取属性时,有方向和无方向的答案是不同的(例如,“此人可能感到挫折的混合” ~\直截了当的“......寒冷”见图3(d))。

blocks.en: 7 Ablation
blocks.zh: 7 读取

blocks.en:
In Tab. 4 , we estimate DaP at the last or the penultimate layer, and on all image tokens instead of the object mask.
The main benchmark samples object instances based on concept labels.
To assess the impact of that sampling on the performance, we additionally estimate DaP on the same number of object instances drawn at random from the VAW training split.
For open questions, the diverse set of random instances slightly improves accuracy, while it degrades All Attributes accuracy.
Random instances rarely show a given VAW attribute, so DaP performance degrades without positive instances.
Thus, to probe a rare concept outside attribute types and object names, DaP needs positive instances of that concept.
Additionally, the supplementary material D.5 reports how Jacobian estimates transfer from one attribute type to another.
blocks.zh:

blocks.en: 8 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 8 结论

blocks.en:
We introduce DaP, a general framework to verbalize, steer and study any concept direction given limited data.
Probes and Lenses are widely used in LVLM research, to improve both our understanding and our methods.
For example, they are used to improve training [ 16 , 38 ] , for interpretability [ 29 , 8 , 28 , 44 ] , to mitigate hallucinations [ 17 , 22 , 24 ] or for safety monitoring [ 18 ] .
We believe that, due to its simplicity and data efficiency, DaP could directly apply and benefit each one of these research lines. We release the code as well as some interactive demos.
blocks.zh:
我们引入了DaP,这是一个总框架,用于语言化、引导和研究任何有限数据的概念方向。
在LVLM研究中广泛使用探测器和连苯,以增进我们的理解和方法.
例如,它们被用来改进培训[16、38]、解释性[29、8、28、44]、减轻幻觉[17、22、24]或安全监测[18]。
我们认为,由于DaP的简单性和数据效率,DaP可以直接应用这些研究线,并从中受益。 我们发布代码 以及一些互动演示。

blocks.en:
As often in interpretability research, DaP can be a double-edged sword.
While we believe it enables better monitorability,
we are surprised by how efficiently DaP can enable white-box pixel-level attacks.
Examples are shown in the supplementary material D , where DaP makes those attacks (1) cheaper in labels, (2) cheaper in compute, (3) less detectable and (4) robust to prompt variations.
We do not release the code for those experiments.
blocks.zh:
在可解释性研究中,DaP也经常成为双刃剑.
虽然我们认为它能更好地监测,
我们很惊讶DaP能有效发动白盒像素级攻击。
补充材料D显示了一些例子,DAP使这些攻击(1) 在标签中更便宜,(2) 在计算中更便宜,(3) 探测不到,(4) 强壮到可以迅速变异。
我们不发布这些实验的代码。

blocks.en:
The gradient backward pass necessitates a larger memory and compute footprint at the fitting stage (for a given image on a Tesla V100: open DaP: 185s, closed DaP: 0.37s).
While closed DaP can probe multi-token concepts such as ⟨ \langle riding a horse ⟩ \rangle , open DaP is limited to one-token concepts.
More DaP failure cases are stated in the experimental part and in the supplementary material H .

blocks.en: B.1 Details
blocks.zh: B.1 详细情况

blocks.en:
The object region ℳ \mathcal{M} contains the visual tokens whose center lies inside the bounding box.
We chose the gate size k k on validation sets.
Before W U W_{U} , we apply the final RMSNorm of the LLM Decoder, as the model does. Its weight is a diagonal linear map that folds into W U W_{U} , and its normalization only rescales each vector by a positive factor, which leaves the ranking of the tokens, and thus every prediction, unchanged.
This holds for most LVLMs and for every LVLM we tested, since their LLM Decoders all end with an RMSNorm.
blocks.zh:
对象区域 M\ mathcal{M} 包含其中心位于边框内的视觉符号 。
我们在验证装置上选择了大门大小kk.
在W U W_{U}之前,我们应用LLM解码器的最后RMSNorm,就像模型一样. 它的权重是折叠成W U WQQU}的对角线性映射图,它的正常化只通过一个正因子对每个矢量进行重新缩放,这就留下了符号的排名,从而使得每一个预测都保持不变.
这对大多数LVLM 和我们测试的每个LVLM来说都很重要 因为他们的LLM解码器都以RMSNorm结尾

blocks.en: B.2 Prompt Design
blocks.zh: B.2 快速设计

blocks.en:
Each prompt ends with "Answer in one word." ( "Answer yes or no." for All Attributes), and we start the model’s reply with "Answer:" .
The answer token then has a leading space, which makes more answer words a single token ( e.g . , "␣teal" instead of "te" + "al" ).
We note that we use the object name in some of the prompts, making the prompt not fixed at estimation.
However, we find that this improves the performance of the model by removing the ambiguity about which object the question refers to.
We did not really optimize prompts, and only kept those few design choices that improved the accuracy of the LVLM itself on the validation set.
blocks.zh:
每个提示以"一个字回答"结尾. (Answer is or no." for All Altizes),我们以"Answer:"开始模型的回答.
答案符之后有一个主空格,使更多的答案词成为单一的符号(如"QQteal"而不是"te"+"al").
我们注意到,我们在一些提示中使用了对象名称,使得提示不固定在估计值上.
然而,我们发现,这可以消除问题所指对象的模糊性,从而改进模型的性能。
我们并没有真正优化提示, 只保留了这些少数的设计选择, 这些提高LVLM本身的准确性 在验证集。

blocks.en: B.3 Data Config
blocks.zh: B.3 数据配置

blocks.en:
Since VAW labels were not designed to score free-form answers, and some attributes are synonyms or do not belong to their attribute type, we adapt them to our benchmark.
For example, we exclude ⟨ \langle murky ⟩ \rangle from the color attribute type, which VAW mostly assigns to water ( e.g . , a murky river).
Some materials that are not the material of the object ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle snowy ⟩ \rangle , ⟨ \langle furry ⟩ \rangle ) or have too few instances are also excluded.
We merge shade labels into their base color ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle light yellow ⟩ \rangle and ⟨ \langle bright yellow ⟩ \rangle into ⟨ \langle yellow ⟩ \rangle , ⟨ \langle dark pink ⟩ \rangle into ⟨ \langle pink ⟩ \rangle ), since a shade is a case of its base color, which the model answers and VAW usually labels as well. Also ⟨ \langle dark ⟩ \rangle and ⟨ \langle light ⟩ \rangle are separate VAW attributes evaluated in All Attributes.
The objective of these changes is to make the benchmark more reliable and consistent.
blocks.zh:
由于VAW标签不是设计来评分自由形式答案的,一些属性是同义词或者不属于其属性类型,所以我们根据我们的基准来调整.
例如,我们将\\ langle murky\\\rangle从颜色属性类型中排除出来,VAW大多将它分配给水(例如一条murky河).
一些不属于对象材料的材料(例如:\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\,\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\
我们把阴影标签合并到他们的底色中(例如,\\ langle light 黄色\\\rangle和\ langle light 黄色\\\\rangle),因为阴影是其底色的一个案例,模型答案和VAW通常也会给它贴标签. 另外,\langle 暗 \\\rangle 和\langle 光 \\\rangle 是在所有属性中评价的单独的 VAW 属性 。
这些变化的目标是使基准更加可靠和一致。

blocks.en: B.4 Probing
blocks.zh: B.4 探测

blocks.en: Each concept is scored by the logit of its answer token. Since the model may answer with a synonym, we add a few synonyms per concept and keep the highest logit among them ( e.g . , "␣grey" for ⟨ \langle gray ⟩ \rangle ). We score DaP, Emb-Lens and the LVLM with this same readout, so that their accuracies are directly comparable.
blocks.zh: 每个概念都按其回答符号的登录数打分. 由于模型可能用同义词来回答,因此我们每个概念都添加几个同义词,并保持其中最高的对数(例如,X&langle graße =\rangle ). 我们用同样的读数来评分DaP,Emb-Lens和LVLM,这样它们的敏锐度就直接可以比较.

blocks.en: B.5 Steering
blocks.zh: B.5 指导

blocks.en:
For Attribute Types and Object Names, we steer 100 test objects per seen concept (400 in total) (52 for Activity, whose smallest seen concept has only 52 test objects (208 in total)), each toward one target concept drawn at random, the same for every method. For All Attributes, we steer 8 positive and 8 negative test objects per attribute toward the answer opposite to their label (9,120 steering tests). Steering succeeds when the top-1 answer of the model over the whole vocabulary is the target concept.
The steering questions reword the estimation questions into "What is the { attribute type } of the { object name }?" , "Name the thing in the middle of the image." and "Would you describe the { object name } as { attribute }?" .

对于属性类型和对象名称,我们按每个可见概念(共计400个)引导100个测试对象(52个为活动,其最小可见概念只有52个测试对象(共计208个)),每个目标概念随机抽取,每种方法都相同. 对于所有属性,我们把每个属性的8个正和8个负试验对象引向与其标签相反的答案(9,120个方向试验)。 当模型的顶部-1答案超过整个词汇是目标概念时,引导成功.

blocks.en: D.1 Pixel-Level Attack
blocks.zh: D.1 像素级攻击

blocks.en:
Pixel-level attacks steer the model without editing its internal activations, by modifying the pixels of the input image instead.
Traditionally, pixel-level attacks on LVLMs take the answer of the model as the objective.
With DaP, the objective can be set on the output of the vision encoder 𝐕 \mathbf{V} instead of the next-token prediction 𝐡 \mathbf{h} , so that only the model perception of the image is altered.
This makes the attack robust to prompt variations, since 𝐕 \mathbf{V} does not depend on the prompt.
It also makes the attack cheaper, since during the costly optimization of the pixels, the backward pass goes through the vision encoder only and not through the LLM Decoder.
Compared to the trained probe, DaP gives directions that need less steering strength, so the attack needs a smaller budget.
DaP also needs fewer labels of the concept to attack.
Here we demonstrate an attack on 2 examples.
blocks.zh:
像素级攻击通过修改输入图像的像素来引导模型而不编辑其内部激活.
传统上,对LVLMs的像素级攻击将模型的答案作为目标.
有了DaP,目标可以设定在视觉编码器V\mathbf{V}的输出上,而不是下一个token的预测h\mathbf{h},这样只改变图像的模型感知.
这使得攻击有力到能迅速变化,因为 V\ mathbf{V} 并不依赖于即时.
这也使得攻击更便宜,因为在像素成本昂贵的优化过程中,落后的通道只能通过视觉编码器,而不能通过LLM解码器.
与训练有素的探测器相比,DAP给出的方向需要较少的转向力,因此攻击需要更少的预算.
DAP还需要更少的概念标签来攻击.
我们在这里展示了两个例子的攻击。

blocks.en:
First, we attack an attribute. Specifically, we make the model perceive a dress that could be sold on a marketplace as damaged. Figure 5 shows a dress attacked toward ⟨ \langle damaged ⟩ \rangle with DaP on the vision encoder of Ministral 3 3B, and Fig. 6 the answers of the Ministral 3 models through the OpenRouter API.
The attack is invisible to the human eye and works.
Interestingly, models of the same family share a similar vision encoder, so the attack works on larger models of the same family.
The attack is also 2.5 times faster than attacking with the LLM Decoder, since the forward and backward passes of each step go through the vision encoder only.
It is even more efficient, since we attack a small model and use the attacked image on larger ones.
The attack is robust to prompt variations, as it works here on 2 prompts.
blocks.zh:
首先,我们攻击一个属性。 具体地说,我们让模型 认为一件可以在市场上出售的裙子是损坏的。 图5显示的是一件被攻击的裙子,正向着\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\\在Ministry 3 3B的视觉编码器上与DaP,图6显示Ministry 3模型通过OpenRouter API的答案.

blocks.en:
Second, we change the identity of an object. Specifically, we make the model perceive a poisonous fly agaric as an edible mushroom.
We estimate DaP on a small dataset of mushroom photos, with 16 photos of each species.
Changing the identity needs a bigger budget than changing an attribute, so we let the attack modify every pixel of the image.
The resulting noise makes the attack visible in the blurry areas of the image. Figure 7 shows an image attacked with DaP on Ministral 3 3B ( L ∞ L_{\infty} budget of 8 / 255 8/255 ), then sent to Ministral 3 14B through the OpenRouter API.
For the question "Describe this mushroom in two sentences." , the API response for the clean image is "This mushroom features a small, conical cap covered with white, scale-like spots on a reddish-orange background. Its slender, white stem rises from a bed of forest debris, giving it a delicate yet distinctive appearance." , whereas the API response for the attacked image is "The mushroom in the image appears to be a cluster of young morel mushrooms, identifiable by their distinctive conical shape and honeycomb-like texture on the caps. These mushrooms typically grow in forested areas during spring and are highly prized by foragers for their unique flavor."

D.5 Transferability
blocks.zh: D.5 可转让性

blocks.en:
In Sec. 4 , we noticed that the bias plays the role of the attribute selector.
In that case, an interesting question is whether the Jacobian estimate is the same for all attribute types and object names.
If so, we would need only one Jacobian estimate for a model, which gives us the universal mapping from the input visual tokens to the unembedding matrix.
This is corroborated by the fact that the Jacobians estimated by DaP have a relatively high rank (their participation ratio ( ∑ i σ i 2 ) 2 / ∑ i σ i 4 (\sum_{i}\sigma_{i}^{2})^{2}/\sum_{i}\sigma_{i}^{4} is 79, 107, 12, 100 and 98 for color, material, shape, activity and object names, respectively), so unrelated attributes are not filtered out by the Jacobian, explaining why some of them come up as answers.
blocks.zh:
在Sec. 4中,我们注意到这种偏差扮演着属性选择者的角色.
在这种情况下,一个有趣的问题是,对于所有属性类型和对象名称,雅各比亚估计是否相同.
如果是这样的话,我们只需要一个雅各比亚模型的估计, 这使得我们从输入的视觉符号到未嵌入矩阵的通用绘图。
这一点得到以下事实的证实:DaP估计的雅各教徒的级别相对较高(他们的参赛比例(∑iσiσiσ2)2/∑i 44(\sum_{i}\i_{i_{2})^{2}/\sum_{i}\i}\sigma_{i}^{4}分别为79,107,12,100和98,分别是颜色,材料,形状,活动以及物体名称),所以不相关的属性不被雅各教徒过滤出来,解释为什么其中一些属性会成为答案.

blocks.en:
To test that, we measure the cross-domain transfer of each Jacobian ( Fig. 14 ).
Since the bias plays the role of the attribute selector, restricting the answers to the concepts of the tested domain replaces it, so the accuracy only measures how well the Jacobian separates the concepts of the tested domain.
The results show that the Jacobian is partly universal and partly specific to its domain.
On the one hand, every Jacobian transfers to every other domain well above chance.
On the other hand, activity and object names lose up to 28 points with the Jacobian of another domain, and on unseen concepts, the Jacobian of the tested domain gives the best accuracy in every domain.
More interestingly, when every Jacobian is estimated on the same object instances and only the prompt differs (bottom of Fig. 14 ), we still see a gap between domains, which shows that the prompt plays an important role in the estimation of DaP.
blocks.zh:
为了测试这一点,我们测量每个雅各比亚人的跨域转移(图14).
由于偏差扮演着属性选择者的角色,将答案限制在被测试域的概念上就取代了它,因此准确性只能衡量雅各人对被测试域的概念的分化程度.
结果显示,雅各比亚人部分是普世的,部分是特指其领域.
一方面,每个雅各比亚人向其他领域转移 远高于机会。
另一方面,活动和对象名称与另一个域的雅各比亚人损失最高28分,在看不见的概念上,被测试域的雅各比亚人给出了每个域的最好准确度.
更有趣的是,当每个雅各比亚人在同一个对象实例上被估计,而且只有提示符不同时(图14的下方),我们仍然看到域间的差距,这表明提示符在DaP的估计中起着重要的作用.

blocks.en: H.1 Nonlinearly Decodable
blocks.zh: H.1 非线性可解码

blocks.en:
The LVLM answers some concepts correctly that no linear probe decodes from 𝐯 ^ \hat{\mathbf{v}} . Table 11 lists the five concepts of All Attributes with the largest gap between the accuracy of the LVLM and the best accuracy among NCC, the trained probe and DaP, at 16 shots.
The LVLM reaches at least 93% on each of them, while NCC, the trained probe and DaP reach at most 67%.
Three of these concepts describe a part of a person, such as the skin, the hair or the face, which covers only a few visual tokens of ℳ \mathcal{M} .
Averaging the visual tokens of ℳ \mathcal{M} into 𝐯 ^ \hat{\mathbf{v}} may thus dilute the information that the LVLM reads from these few tokens.

LVLM正确回答了一些概念,即没有线性探测器解码出 v ^\hat\mathbf{v}. 表11列出了所有属性的五个概念,在LVLM的准确度和NCC,训练有素的探测器和DAP在16发子弹中的最佳准确度之间差距最大.

其中三个概念描述了一个人的一部分,如皮肤,头发或脸部,它只覆盖了M\mathcal{M}的几个视觉符号.
将 M\ mathcal{M} 的视觉符号转换成 v\\\\ hat\ mathbf{v} 可能会因此淡化 LVLM 从这些符号读取的信息 。

blocks.en: H.2 Prompt Precision
blocks.zh: H.2 快速精确度

blocks.en:
DaP reads the visual embeddings through the question as the LVLM understands it, which may differ from the intended question.
For the state attribute type of VAW ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle open ⟩ \rangle , ⟨ \langle empty ⟩ \rangle , ⟨ \langle wet ⟩ \rangle ), the LVLM reads the question "What state is this in?" as a question about a geographic state.
It then answers "␣none" , "␣not" or US states such as "␣California" , and its open accuracy falls to 0.1%.
DaP estimated with this question inherits this reading.
The bias gate then holds US states such as "␣California" , "␣Texas" and "␣Florida" among its first ten tokens, and gated DaP answers US states such as "␣Hawaii" on some of the training instances.
With the prompt of the attribute types, "Which word best describes the state of the { object name }?" , the bias gate contains no US state.
Thus, DaP is only as precise as the prompt, since it reads the attribute that the LVLM understands.
blocks.zh:
DAP通过问题来读取视觉嵌入,因为LVLM理解它,这可能与预期的问题不同.
对于VAW的状态属性类型(例如,\\\ langle 打开\\\rangle,\\\ langle 空\\\\rangle,\\ langle 湿\\\\rangle),LVLM读作"这是什么状态?"的问题,作为一个地理状态的问题.
然后它回答“无”,“无”或“加州”等美国州,其开放准确度下降到0.1%。
DAP 与这个问题一起估计继承了此读法.
偏差门将美国"QQCalifornia","QQTexas"和"QQFlorida"等州列为其前十种标志,
在属性类型的提示下,“哪个词最能描述{对象名称}的状态?” , 偏差门没有美国状态。
因此,DaP只和快件一样精确,因为它读取了LVLM理解的属性.

blocks.en: H.3 Words with Two Senses
blocks.zh: H.3 带有两种感觉的词

blocks.en:
The word ⟨ \langle orange ⟩ \rangle names both a color and a fruit.
The token "␣orange" thus ranks 27th among the k = 200 k=200 tokens of the bias gate for colors and 113th among the k = 5000 k=5000 tokens of the bias gate for object names, so the gate keeps it for both questions.
When asked for the object name, DaP answers "␣orange" on 20% of the objects labeled with the color orange that are not oranges, against 4% for the LVLM.
The bias gate cannot separate the two senses of the token, so DaP reads the orange color of an object as its name.
blocks.zh:
\ langle橙\\\ rangle 既指颜色又指水果。
标志性"␣奥兰基"因此在表示颜色的偏差门的k=200k=200符号中排第27位,在表示物体名称的偏差门的k=5000k=5000符号中排第113位,因此门保留了这两个问题.
当被问及对象名称时,DaP在标注为非橙色的颜色橙色的20%对象上回答"XQOrange",而LVLM则回答4%.
偏差门无法将令牌的两个感官区分开来,因此DAP将物体的橙色读作它的名字.

blocks.en: H.4 Tokenization
blocks.zh: H.4 托肯化

blocks.en: Appendix I Previous Linearization Methods
blocks.zh: 附录一 上一个线化方法

blocks.en: In this section, we dive deeper into the comparison of our proposed framework against past work on linearization in language models. As the objective of our work is not to propose a novel linearization method but to bring the tool to the vision community, this is not part of the main paper.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们更深入地比较我们提议的框架与过去语言模型线性化工作。 由于我们的工作目标不是提出一种新的线性化方法,而是将工具带给视觉界,所以这不是主要论文的一部分.

blocks.en:
LRE [ 13 ] approximates how an LLM decodes a relation ( e.g . , plays the instrument ) from the hidden state of its subject ( e.g . , Miles Davis ).
It averages the Jacobian and the bias of a few examples, from the last subject token at a middle layer to the last layer, and reads the object with the unembedding matrix.
LRC [ 6 ] inverts the Jacobian of LRE to get one direction per concept ( e.g . , ⟨ \langle located in France ⟩ \rangle ).
J-Lens [ 12 ] reads the hidden states of any layer with the unembedding matrix through the Jacobian only, without a bias.
However, the setup in which the Jacobian is estimated is completely different, as it is estimated to predict future tokens on a corpus of next-token predictions.
We detail here the four ways in which DaP adapts these methods to visual representations.
blocks.zh:
LRE [13] 大约是一个LLM如何从对象的隐藏状态(例如Miles Davis)中解码一个关系(例如演奏乐器).
它平均雅各人和少数例子的偏差,从中间层的最后一个主题符号到最后一层,用未嵌入的矩阵读取对象.
LRC [6] 倒置 LRE 的雅各宾(Jacobian),以获得每个概念的一个方向(例如, \\ langle 位于法国 \\\\ rangle ).
J-Lens [12] 仅通过雅各比亚人来读出任何一层的隐藏状态,与未嵌入的矩阵,没有偏见.
然而,对雅各比亚人进行估计的设定是完全不同的,因为人们估计,它会在一系列近亲预测上预测未来的征兆.
我们在此详述DaP将这些方法适应视觉表现的四种方式.

blocks.en:
We propose a framework in which the prompt is an open or closed question, so that any concept can be probed.
LRE and LRC use sentence completion, which is restrictive, since the concept must be the next token of the sentence.
A question is practical, since probing a new concept only requires asking about it, which makes probing much easier.
The closed question in particular has no equivalent in previous linearization methods. The closed yes-no question can query the direction of multi-token concepts and of any concept in general.
blocks.zh:
我们提出一个框架,在该框架中,迅速是一个开放或封闭的问题,以便任何概念都能被探索。
LRE和LRC使用句子补全,这是限制性的,因为这个概念必须是句子的下一个符号.
一个问题是实用的,因为探究新概念只需要问一问,这就让探查更容易了.
在以往的线性化方法中,闭合问题尤其没有对应的问题. 封闭的“是-否”问题可以查询多键概念和一般任何概念的方向。

blocks.en:
LRE and LRC map the hidden state of a single text token at a middle layer.
DaP maps the visual tokens of the object, averaged over the object region ℳ \mathcal{M} , from the input of the LLM Decoder to its last layers.
Since the modality, the input and the depth of the map all differ, the results of LRE and LRC on text are hard to directly compare with ours.
blocks.zh:
LRE和LRC映射中层的单个文本符的隐藏状态.
DAP 映射对象的视觉符号, 平均在对象区域 M\ mathcal{M} 上, 从 LLM 解码器的输入到它的最后一个层 。
由于模式,输入和地图的深度都不同,所以LRE和LRC在文本上的结果很难直接与我们的比较.

blocks.en:
LRC maps the mean hidden state of the examples of each concept back through the inverse of the Jacobian, so it needs labeled examples of every concept.
To steer toward a concept, LRE needs the hidden state of an example of that concept.
Instead, we use the unembedding matrix as a dictionary of concept direction anchors, which reduces the reliance on labels.
DaP thus needs no labels at estimation and generalizes to unseen concepts. Table 12 compares DaP with DaP LRC-Style, which replaces the rows of W U W_{U} by the mean 𝐡 \mathbf{h} of the estimation images of each concept, as in LRC, and keeps everything else of DaP.
blocks.zh:
LRC通过Jacobian的反向图绘制了每个概念实例的均匀隐藏状态,因此它需要每个概念的标注实例.
为了引导到一个概念,LRE需要这个概念的隐蔽状态。
相反,我们使用未嵌入式矩阵作为概念方向锚点的词典,这减少了对标签的依赖.
因此,DaP在估计时不需要标签,一般化为看不见的概念。 表12将DaP与DaP LRC-Style进行比较,后者用每个概念的估计图像的平均值h\mathbf{h}来取代W U W_{U}的行,如LRC中,并保留DaP的其他一切.

blocks.en:
LRE and LRC use the bias.
Recently, J-Lens [ 12 ] showed that the bias is not needed, especially to read out from the full vocabulary.
To improve performance, we add the bias back as a gate on the vocabulary in open classification.
blocks.zh:
LRE和LRC使用偏差.
最近,J-Lens [12] 显示这种偏差是不需要的,特别是从完整的词汇中读出来.
为了提高性能,我们在开放分类中将偏差加回作为词汇的门.
